tree.heading: Organization.—
tree.text: There is an Office of Federal Procurement Policy in the Office of Management and Budget.

tree.heading: Purposes.—
tree.text: The purposes of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy are to—

children.text: provide overall direction of Government-wide procurement policies, regulations, procedures, and forms for executive agencies; and
promote economy, efficiency, and effectiveness in the procurement of property and services by the executive branch of the Federal Government.

tree.heading: Authorization of Appropriations.—
tree.text: Necessary amounts may be appropriated each fiscal year for the Office of Federal Procurement Policy to carry out the responsibilities of the Office for that fiscal year.
